name: design-system
description: Framework- and CSS-library-agnostic visual foundation applied before the first component exists: an explicit pixel typography scale with semantic names, a design-token catalog (colors, spacing, radius, shadows, interaction states), and five responsive breakpoint tiers for enterprise-desktop-primary applications — plus one Tailwind adapter skill that writes those tokens into a real app.css @theme block. Exists so font sizes, colors, and spacing are chosen from a named scale rather than invented per component.
